description: This file defines the progress bar UI component and its associated methods for rendering, updating, monitoring via Ajax, and error handling within a Drupal project.

classes.name: Drupal.ProgressBar
classes.description: A JavaScript object representing a progress bar, capable of rendering, updating progress, monitoring server status via Ajax, and handling errors.

methods.name: setProgress
methods.description: Updates the visual progress and messages of the progress bar.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Begins polling the server for progress updates via Ajax.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops polling the server for progress updates.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Sends an Ajax request to retrieve progress data from the server.

methods.name: displayError
methods.description: Displays an error message on the page.
